title: Pohela Boishakh (Bengali New Year)
organizer: Ministry of Cultural Affairs & Tourism Board
description: The biggest secular national festival of Bangladesh. Celebrated with the Mangal Shobhajatra parade (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), traditional Panta Ilish breakfast, traditional music, and colorful street art.

title: Dublar Char Rash Mela
description: A 200-year-old traditional seaside festival held on a remote island in the Sundarbans during the full moon of November. Thousands of pilgrims assemble for holy dips in the sea, folk performances, and artisanal fairs.

title: Chittagong Hill Tracts Biju & Sangrai
description: The New Year festival of the Chakma, Marma, and Tripura communities. Features floating flowers in river streams, water-splashing rituals (Sangrai), traditional sports, and community feasts.

title: Dhaka International Folk Fest
description: The largest folk music event in South Asia, gathering legendary Baul singers, Sufi musicians, and international world music artists for three nights of mesmerizing music.

title: National Tourism Day & Food Expo
description: Celebrating World Tourism Day with nationwide travel discounts, traditional Bengali cuisine food stalls, photography exhibitions, and tour operator expos.
